message: 生きたカード

name: Synn
message: 「Oh no! I have to renew my library card!」
After school, I hurry toward the library.
In one hand, I hold a somewhat worn-out library card.
I didn't think I had borrowed all that many books since entering Ryuusei Academy, yet when I took a closer look, the checkout log on the back was completely full.
After one more book, there won't be any space left to write.

name: Paqy
message: 「A cardboard library card in this day and age?!」

name: Synn
message: 「I was surprised at first too. I wondered why they weren't electronic cards.」

name: Paqy
message: 「No kidding. In this golden age of PCs, managing them would be way easier.」
Melilot was standing quietly by the bench in front of the library. I'm in luck. Outside the building, we can talk normally.

name: Synn
message: 「Hello.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, hello.」
Looking closely, Melilot is holding a library card in her hand just like me. Judging by the faint smudges of dirt on it, someone must have dropped it.

name: Melilot
message: 「Renewed over and over, onto their twentieth library card... Heehee, this student is quite the avid reader.」

name: Synn
message: 「Should I take it over to the student affairs office?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No, knowing this owner, they will be along shortly.」
I feel relieved.
Rumor has it that if you make noise in the library, damage a book, or miss a due date, Melilot will put you through something terrifying. However, losing a library card is an exception.

name: Melilot
message: 「Oh? You have your card with you too, Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, I was thinking of renewing it.」

name: Melilot
message: 「That is a wonderful thing.」

name: Melilot
message: 「...Do you remember what I said on the day you made your card?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course!」
Right after enrolling, I visited the library, met Melilot, showed her my student handbook, and had her make my card.
As she handed that old-fashioned cardboard card to a new student, Melilot--the older librarian whose name I didn't even know back then--wrapped up her explanation like this.

name: Synn
message: 「'Please take good care of it'--right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Heehee.」
Just as I promised Melilot that day, I've taken great care of my library card.

It has yellowed by now and its corners are frayed, yet on the checkout column on the back, the titles of the books I've borrowed over the roughly year and a half since entering Ryuusei Academy remain clearly recorded.

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san, you said one more thing, didn't you?」

name: Melilot
message: 「What books one has read is also proof of how one has lived――is what I said.」
That's right. Up until now, I haven't spoken with Melilot-san all that much.
Even so, I can clearly remember every word we've exchanged. I don't know anyone else who speaks as logically yet poetically as Melilot-san.

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha, we're already more than halfway through second year, and I've finally used up just one card.」
I trace the titles recorded in the checkout column on the back of the library card, one by one from the very top.
Just doing that brings back memories of where I was and how I read those books back then.
Not only the contents of the books, but also the conversations I had with Melilot-san.

name: Synn
message: 「Twenty cards, huh? That student is amazing.」

name: Melilot
message: 「It is Cristeles-san.」

name: Synn
message: 「So it was Misa. I wonder what kind of books she reads? Let's see here――」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaaaaah!? Why is Sakura-kun right there?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Right, with Misa's personality, of course she'd rush over here to get it.」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't look at my card!」

name: Misa
message: 「Take this, Jumping Hip Attaaack!」

name: Synn
message: 「Guhah!」
The instant she lands a blow on me, Misa snatches back her library card with deft sleight of hand.

name: Misa
message: 「What do you think you're doing! Peeking into a girl's private life disqualifies you from being Student Council President!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You have a point there, sorry.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I have indeed handed it over to you, Cristeles-san.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, yes, thank you very much.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Now then, Sakura-kun, I will issue you a new library card. Please step up to the counter.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, please.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, do I return the old card?」

name: Melilot
message: 「There is no need for that; please keep it safe. Even after you graduate, forever.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, is that so?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph! Not even knowing something like that, you really are a hopeless person!」

name: Melilot
message: 「You didn't know either when you made your second one, did you, Christeles?」

name: Misa
message: 「Ngggh...」
I got my second library card. By simple math, I'll be graduating right around the time this card fills up.
Whenever I want to see Melilot, all I have to do is pull out this library card.
With just that, unchanging memories come rushing back.
I didn't realize that until many years after graduation.
